vibe: A warm, visual builder whose site is a painted desk with a tangerine, books and plants, where the agent's demo plays on the screen.
lines: Meet Tangerine! It follows what you're working on and explains useful findings in the language you're learning.
The idea is simple: new words stick better when they're tied to stuff you already care about.
Tangerine runs a loop: observe, gate, judge, act, send, with feedback looping back in.
Noticing, growing, surprising. That's what I want an ambient companion to feel like.
Another idea was Sift, for anyone drowning in newsletters, papers and saved links.
And Pip! A playful agent with its own memory that can decide when to talk or stay quiet.
This week I'm with Group 5, building personalization for the Course Agent.
